title: Resistome
description: Antibiotic-resistance decision support from bacterial genome assemblies. Predicts likely-to-work / likely-to-fail / no-call for five antibiotics against Klebsiella pneumoniae, with calibrated confidence, evidence tiers, and an explicit no-call when the evidence is insufficient. Research prototype — confirm with lab testing.

title: InsightFlow
description: "An autonomous agentic decision intelligence platform that ingests multi-source data, resolves contradictions via parallel multi-agent debate, validates constraints, and triggers real-world email, Slack, and Sheets actions."
